segments.title: Chương 7: Đối thủ tiềm năng
segments.content:
Chapter 7: Potential Love Rival

If he had asked to borrow Xu Qianqian's vocabulary book back then, the effect might have been even better. After some thought, Jiang Nian decided it wasn't necessary.

Skills were valued for their quality, not quantity, and the main stumbling block at the moment was the college entrance exam. The 3,500-word vocabulary was enough; it would be better to spend the precious memory time on other subjects.

At this moment, with the Subject Memory, Jiang Nian was breezing through his practice questions.

Damn it, even after memorizing the math formulas, he still couldn't solve the problems.

He could ace English in seconds, and with Subject Memory for biology and chemistry, they were much easier than before. He didn't bother with Chinese, since it was pointless even if he did. As for physics, um...

With one year left until the college entrance exam, Jiang Nian figured he should have no problem getting into a decent university if he worked hard.

There were a total of three evening self-study sessions in the classroom.

During almost every break, you could hear the sounds of playful fighting and laughter from Zhou Yuting's little clique. "Shameless and wild" was a phrase Jiang Nian rarely used to describe a group of people.

But that's what they were, shameless and wild.

In the pauses between his practice problems, Jiang Nian would occasionally look up in that direction. In the past, he would have probably thrown down his pen and run over to join their laughter.

It wasn't that he wanted to be a simp, but that he liked to fit in.

Even without Zhou Yuting, he would have wanted to join this group of "popular kids." To put it bluntly, Jiang Nian was good-looking and wanted to use his looks to buy into the clique.

He couldn't focus on his studies, nor was he particularly wealthy, so his insecurity inevitably led to a bit of vanity.

The popular clique held a great attraction for teenage boys, with pretty girls, rich classmates, and the top-performing, fun-loving guys in the class.

Joining them, laughing and joking around, not only satisfied his vanity but also gave him a sense of "superiority" that didn't belong to a goblin.

Now, Jiang Nian no longer had such childish thoughts.

Perhaps he had seen through it all, or maybe he had been impacted by the system's worldview. In any case, he was a little tired and didn't want to get mixed up with this shameless and trashy crowd anymore.

The three self-study sessions passed peacefully. The head teacher came by once, said a few words about the schedule and next week's monthly exam, and then left.

The final self-study session ended at 9:40 PM.

Jiang Nian followed the crowd out, making eye contact with Zhou Yuting as he passed the doorway. In reality, his mind was preoccupied with a math problem, his gaze completely unfocused.

He passed by in a flash, without the slightest hesitation.

The classroom doorway was crowded and noisy. It was late September, and Zhou Yuting was still wearing a figure-hugging pink short-sleeved shirt. Below, she wore jeans that tightly wrapped around her hips.

Zhennan County High didn't require a uniform, only mandating that all students wear the summer or autumn school uniform on special occasions like sports meets or the Monday flag-raising ceremony.

A sixteen-year-old girl looked youthful in anything, not to mention a budding beauty like Zhou Yuting, with a chest like the gentle ridges of a spring mountain and those long, slender legs.

She could hardly believe it. She was just about to greet him, he clearly saw her, right? He just passed by in a flash like that?

They used to be quite close.

She hadn't cared much about Jiang Nian anyway. She only hung out with him because he was good-looking and had a good physique from playing basketball.

Even when he inexplicably left her circle, Zhou Yuting didn't feel much of anything. After all, apart from his body, Jiang Nian had nothing else that could attract her.

Seven or eight minutes later, Zhou Yuting walked out of the classroom with her two best friends.

Suddenly, one of them, He Cai, let out a soft "Huh?"

"Isn't that Jiang Nian?"

At her words, Zhou Yuting and the other girl, Luo Wanzhen, subconsciously turned to look. They saw Jiang Nian standing at the doorway of the next class, walking alongside a short girl.

They would brush against each other from time to time, looking quite familiar with one another.

"He's in a relationship? How come we never heard him mention it? No wonder he hasn't been hanging out with us lately," Luo Wanzhen remarked with a click of her tongue, half-joking. She didn't have any ill feelings toward Jiang Nian.

"Isn't that girl from the Olympiad class next door? How did he..."

"Who knows. She looks pretty average." Zhou Yuting, like a proud swan, glanced at the girl walking with Jiang Nian, who was dressed in an ordinary, girl-next-door style.

Xu Qianqian was very pretty and had nice clothes at home, but she dressed rather plainly at school.

In the eyes of a girl like Zhou Yuting, she was just average.

"Didn't Jiang Nian have a crush on you before?" He Cai's tone was a little provocative. Although the three of them were best friends, she and Luo Wanzhen had a small group chat without Zhou Yuting. Of course, Zhou Yuting and Luo Wanzhen also had one without He Cai.

"Who he likes has nothing to do with me," Zhou Yuting said with a toss of her head, walking toward the school gate. "I don't like him anyway."

"Teach you math?" Xu Qianqian walked alongside Jiang Nian, the knuckles of her fingers gripping her backpack strap turning slightly white. "What's with the sudden change of heart?"

The long street of the county town was still lit, lights flickering on and off, stretching toward the horizon.

She felt like she was meeting Jiang Nian for the first time, studying him over and over again.

"This afternoon, you even threw away the vocabulary book."

"That's because I've already memorized them all. You can test me if you don't believe me," Jiang Nian said, knowing he couldn't hide it. "Pick any word from the 3,500-word college entrance exam list."

Xu Qianqian thought for a moment and chose a simple one.

"Connect?"

"To link. C-O-N..." Jiang Nian answered without a second thought.

Slightly surprised, Xu Qianqian picked a more obscure one.

"Stimulate?"

"To arouse. S-T-I..." Jiang Nian recited fluently.

This time, Xu Qianqian was completely stunned. She stood at the street corner, staring at Jiang Nian. The expression on her face was as if she had seen a ghost, her mouth opening several times without a sound coming out.

"Are... are you Jiang Nian?"

"Isn't that obvious? You can check the goods if you don't believe me." He pursed his lips and explained, "I was just pretending before because I wanted to fit into their circle..."

He couldn't say too much. The more he said, the less convincing he would be.

To Xu Qianqian's ears, however, this explanation was reasonable. She believed that someone who could cook so well couldn't possibly be that dumb.

Besides, that idiot Jiang Nian was really capable of doing something like this.

"I don't even know what to say to you. Do you think you're doing right by Uncle Jiang and Auntie Li?" Xu Qianqian could be stubborn at times, and when she got fixated on something, she was truly relentless.

Seeing her stern little face, Jiang Nian couldn't help but smile.

"I know, I know. Haven't I turned over a new leaf now? Don't worry, I won't let you teach me for free. How about I make you something delicious this weekend?"

Gulp. Xu Qianqian swallowed, the sound a little loud.

"I can teach you math, for Auntie Li's sake. But forget about the food, I'm on a diet recently."

Hearing Xu Qianqian's disingenuous words, Jiang Nian couldn't help but smile.

Suddenly, he heard her ask, "Do you still like Zhou Yuting?"

The night wind blew past. Under the dim yellow streetlights, Jiang Nian fell silent for two seconds.

"I don't."

In that second he hesitated, he actually wanted to say he disliked her, but it wouldn't be right to say that in front of Xu Qianqian.

"Ding!"

[Your thirty-eight-year-old self has discovered a potential love rival. Besides you, someone has been silently watching over Xu Qianqian. Due to his poor family background, he never spoke to Xu Qianqian from high school through college. Now, he has become successful in his career.

Mission: Defeat the formidable love rival, Zhou Haifei, and make him give up on Xu Qianqian.

Reward: 5000 RMB.]

(End of this chapter)
